record.oneLiner: Twilio SendGrid is a cloud email API for sending transactional email, managing contacts and running marketing campaigns.
record.verdictReason: API access is a 60-day timed free trial (100 sends per day via Web API or SMTP); sending stops after the trial unless a paid Email API plan is chosen. Twilio hosts an official MCP server, but it is documentation-lookup only (read-only, no SendGrid send operations), so it does not provide email-sending tools.

evidence.quote: The Twilio SendGrid Web API v3 supports API keys, which add an additional layer of security to your account.
Twilio SendGrid supports Basic Authentication using an API key as your password value for some services.
users will be given a 60 day timed free trial plan
email send via any web API or SMTP integration for the account will stop unless an appropriate "Email API" plan is chosen
provides a REST interface to send email at scale
This server is read-only: it searches and retrieves public API documentation
